那个扔出龙肉的老者大声喊道，同时将自己的本名魔兽也释放了出来。

百余名守卫弟子尽数木然地立在原地，像是被定身了一般，一动也不动。

那少年手中拿着一把黑色的古朴长枪，枪尖正刺在诸葛林风的右肩上。鲜血顺着枪尖流下，一会儿便将地上染红了。

范家父子三人几乎一夜没睡，但第二天还要上朝，不得已只好终止了审问，简单梳洗一下，吃过早饭各自上朝去了。

说着，话就顿住了。想起陶氏是屋里的老人，还是他的次子盛乐钰的生母，终究给她留了几分体面，没有在东瑗面前说陶氏的不是。

其实不用那吴长老说，冷阳也猜到必然是和金刚门有关。凭自己的修为实力，对上金刚门只有死路一条，如今唯一的希望就是莫之遥。冷阳当然不会对莫之遥有所避讳，也是借机试探莫之遥的反应。

叶青听到那个所谓的三王子居然如此强大，看来也是一个了不得的人物。只是听韩冰冰的意思，那三王子似乎今年并不在这里。

“知道了！”齐飞应了一声，连忙一步一晃地走到窗台边——似乎是刚睡醒的关系，他感觉还有点头晕脑胀走路不稳。

大家见李紫玉没有丝毫主子的架子，说话也很平和、亲近，紧张、拘谨的神经不禁放松了下来。于是，大家就把自己所会的东西都告诉了李紫玉。

“梁晓光，想不到你们能请到大名鼎鼎的土钵法师道应！”孔叔说道。

The old man who threw the dragon meat shouted loudly, and at the same time he released his own monster.

The more than a hundred guard disciples all stood there numbly, as if they were immobilized, motionless.

The young man held a simple black spear in his hand, and the tip of the spear was piercing Zhuge Linfeng's right shoulder.Blood flowed down the tip of the gun, and soon the ground was dyed red.

The Fan family, father and son, barely slept all night, but they had to go to court the next day, so they had no choice but to terminate the interrogation, freshen up briefly, and go to court each after breakfast.

As he spoke, he paused.Remembering that Mrs. Tao was the old man in the house and the biological mother of his second son Sheng Leyu, she finally left her some dignity and did not say anything wrong about Mrs. Tao in front of Dong Yuan.

In fact, Elder Wu didn't need to say anything, Leng Yang also guessed that it must be related to the Vajra Gate.With his own cultivation strength, there is only a dead end against the Vajra Sect. Now the only hope is Mo Zhiyao.Of course, Leng Yang would not shy away from Mo Zhiyao, and he also took the opportunity to test Mo Zhiyao's reaction.

Ye Qing heard that the so-called third prince was actually so powerful, and he seemed to be an extraordinary person.Just from what Han Bingbing said, it seems that the third prince is not here this year.

"Got it!" Qi Fei responded and hurriedly walked to the window sill step by step - it seemed that he had just woken up, he felt a little dizzy and unsteady on his feet.

Everyone saw that Li Ziyu didn't have any airs of being a master, and spoke very calmly and intimately, so their nervous and reserved nerves couldn't help but relax.So everyone told Li Ziyu everything they knew.

"Liang Xiaoguang, I never thought you could invite the famous Tubo Master Daoying!" Uncle Kong said.
